fields.title: If exists
fields.description:
Specify the behavior of the node in case the output file already exists.
  • Fail: Will issue an error during the node's execution (to prevent unintentional overwrite).
  • Overwrite: Will replace any existing file.
  • Ignore: Will ignore if a file already exists and continues the copying process.

fields.title: Create missing folders
fields.description: If enabled, missing folders in the specified path will be created automatically.

fields.title: Binary object
fields.description: Column containing the binary objects to write.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Remove binary object column
fields.description: If checked, the column containing the binary objects is removed from the output table.

fields.title: Compress binary object files (gzip)
fields.description: If checked, the output binary files will be compressed to gzip.

fields.title: File generation mode
fields.description: Select how output file names should be determined.

fields.title: File names
fields.description: The file names will be generated using the provided pattern. The pattern must contain a single "?" symbol. This symbol will, during execution, be replaced by an incrementing counter to make the filenames unique. This node does not append any file extension.

fields.title: File name column
fields.description: Column containing the file names under which the corresponding binary file will be stored.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица
